verdict.rationale: Formant's own marketing documents configurable alerts and automated incident detection on real-time fleet telemetry, and its docs show Formant events can trigger outbound webhooks. Nothing specifically documents fault, battery, or connectivity alert types, and the alerting claims come only from marketing pages rather than detailed configuration docs. Missing for 10: documented alert rules for robot faults, battery thresholds and connectivity/offline status, in-depth alert configuration docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops lead, I can get alerts on robot faults, battery, and connectivity so issues are caught before customers notice

citations.quote: Real-time telemetry and status updates across your entire fleet. Configurable alerts and automated incident detection
Set up alerts for anomalies, track mission progress, and respond to issues before they become downtime.
A webhook allows you to make an API call to any endpoint over HTTP based on a trigger from a Formant event.
